item.title: Traffic Alert: I-45 NB ML – Willis – Wrong-Way 18-Wheeler
item.description: 8:45 p.m. DPS has stopped an 18-wheeler headed southbound in the northbound lanes of I-45, just north of Longstreet Road. Thankfully, they stopped the vehicle before it hit anyone.

item.title: Traffic Alert: Baptist Encampment Rd. – New Caney – Wreck / Entrapment Reported
item.description: 9:10 p.m. Baptist Encampment Road at FM 1485 – Crash w/ two vehicles. One vehicle is in the ditch.

item.title: DPS TROOPER PREVENTS WOULD BE DISASTER ON I-45
item.description: Just before 9pm a DPS Trooper was at the intersection of FM 1097 and I-45 monitoring traffic on FM 1097 and southbound I-45 feeder.
